_comment: Table anglaise de tout ce qui vient des donnees. types / categories / forms sont generes depuis PokeAPI (voir tools/build_i18n.md). labels vient de tools/.cache/pokemon_form_names.csv, la table PokeAPI dont tools/build_forms.py a tire le francais — meme source des deux cotes, donc correspondance exacte. cosmetics et games sont traduits a la main et relus. Les categories sont clees par NUMERO NATIONAL : six categories francaises couvrent plusieurs libelles anglais (« Pokemon Poisson » vaut Fish, Goldfish, Angler et Water Fish). Les formes sont clees par leur cle PokeAPI. Le reste est cle par le francais, qui est la langue source du site.

ui.Appuie sur une vignette pour la retirer: Tap a thumbnail to drop it from the batch, or put it back. The word underneath gives the confidence: “sure” when the official sprite matches and no other comes close, “recheck” when two candidates are neck and neck. The numbers are in the tooltip. The grayed-out ones are already in your collection — they won't be rewritten.

ui.Ce Pokémon est verrouillé chromatique da: This Pokémon is shiny-locked in every game it appears in, or exists only in Gen. I, which has no shinies. Its shiny is still obtainable by distribution or through HOME: the box therefore counts towards “all obtained”.
ui.Cette espèce a des apparences mâle et fe: This species has different male and female appearances: tick every box you own. As soon as a shiny is ticked, the thumbnail switches to its shiny version.
ui.Cette lecture se trompe. Elle reconnaît: This reader gets things wrong. It recognizes a drawing 20 pixels across among 2,663 sprites that look alike — a Pidgey and a Pidgeotto, a male Nidoran and a female Nidoran. It's good, not infallible.
ui.Chaque case est ensuite détourée de son: Each box is then cut out from its background, shrunk to a 20 × 20 fingerprint — three color channels plus the silhouette — and compared to the fingerprints of the 2,663 official sprites. The closest one wins.
ui.Chaque forme a son propre sprite normal: Each form has its own normal and shiny sprite. What you tick is at the top.
ui.Chaque variante est une entrée distincte: Each variant is a separate entry in HOME: tick the top square for the normal version, the bottom star for the shiny. The first tile is the species' base form.
Each variant is a separate entry in HOME, on top of the standard form above: tick the top square for the normal version, the bottom star for the shiny.

ui.Elle ne coche donc jamais rien toute seu: So it never ticks anything on its own.
ui.Elle te montre ce qu'elle a cru voir, tu: It shows you what it thinks it saw, you drop what's wrong, and it's your tap that writes it. A box ticked by mistake would go into data/collection.json on GitHub without you ever seeing it.
ui.Et pose ton filtre sur le jeu d'origine: And set your filter to the original game “Pokémon GO”: only your GO Pokémon will be listed, so only those get read.
ui.Et si tu t'aperçois trop tard qu'un lot: And if you notice too late that a batch was bad: the “Undo” banner takes back the whole read in a single tap.
ui.Exporte et remplace data/collection.json: Export and replace data/collection.json to lock these changes into the repository.
ui.HOME range par numéro national : la suit: HOME sorts by National Dex number: your screenshots run in increasing order. The site first keeps only the clear-cut matches, which become anchors; then, between two anchors, a box can only be a species from that range. A thousand candidates drop to a handful, and a middling match becomes conclusive. Six passes, each one tightening the next. Any match that would break the order is thrown out, whatever its score — that's why dropping the screenshots out of order degrades the result a lot.
Order matters a lot — see below.
ui.Laisse une ligne de recouvrement entre d: Leave one row of overlap between two screenshots. It isn't a nicety: that overlap is what catches the boxes hidden by HOME's two floating buttons.
ui.Le chromatique n'est pas deviné : les sp: The shiny isn't guessed: normal and shiny sprites are both in the comparison, and the color of the drawing settles it.
ui.Le jeu ne génère jamais cette espèce en: The game never generates this species as a shiny.
ui.Le site repère la grille dans ta capture: The site finds the grid in your screenshot: it looks for the columns and rows of sprites by counting, column by column, the pixels that aren't background. Nothing is hard-coded — so it works on any phone, whatever the height of your status bar.
